title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Classify polygons with all regular symplectic billiard orbits periodic, decide whether every polygon has some periodic orbit, and establish whether the symplectic stadium dynamics is chaotic.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200015 (AMR-051-0015). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Serge Tabachnikov, Problem 3, pp. 11--12.
